title: Towards fully automated city operations: Integrating agentic AI with urban digital twins
authors: Haowen Xu; Sisi Zlatanova; Xueping Li; Monica Wachowicz; Michael Batty
abstract: The convergence of generative AI, the emerging agentic AI paradigm, the Model Context Protocol (MCP), and urban digital twins (UDTs) present transformative potential for automating the management of complex urban systems. In this paper, we address how agentic digital twins can generate knowledge-augmented workflows through multi-step reasoning and autonomously execute them via coordinated AI agents equipped with diverse scientific tools. Such agents are capable of discovering and retrieving relevant data, constructing analytical pipelines, interfacing with domain-specific software, and adapting to dynamic urban conditions and user-defined scenarios through reflective reasoning. Drawing on advances in agentic software systems, both from interactive media and personal assistance, and societal, built and operational applications, we illustrate how this paradigm enables knowledge-driven problem solving and automated orchestration of scientific tools to support real-time city operations. Building on our prior prototype development (the RECOIL project) and recent advances in agentic AI systems for smart city applications, we extend and adapt existing agentic AI design principles to align with the functional pillars and lifecycle requirements of UDTs. Based on this synthesis, we propose a more mature and generalized architectural framework to enable automated city-scale operations, including urban logistics, traffic optimization, building energy management, and disaster response. Finally, we outline key research directions and challenges for deploying agentic AI into UDTs, highlighting a pathway towards scalable, user-focused, and semi-autonomous management of complex interdisciplinary urban systems.
abstractZh: 生成式人工智能、新兴智能体式人工智能范式、模型上下文协议（MCP）与城市数字孪生（UDT）的融合，为复杂城市系统管理的自动化带来变革潜力。本文探讨智能体式数字孪生如何通过多步推理生成知识增强工作流，并借助配备多种科学工具、相互协调的AI智能体自主执行。这些智能体能够发现和检索相关数据、构建分析流程、对接领域软件，并通过反思性推理适应动态城市条件及用户定义情景。我们借鉴交互媒体、个人助理以及社会、建成环境和运营应用中的智能体软件系统进展，说明该范式如何通过知识驱动的问题解决和科学工具自动编排，支持实时城市运行。基于既有RECOIL原型开发及智慧城市智能体AI系统的最新进展，研究扩展并调整现有设计原则，使其契合UDT的功能支柱与生命周期要求。在此综合基础上，我们提出更成熟、通用的架构框架，以支持城市物流、交通优化、建筑能耗管理和灾害响应等城市尺度自动化运行。最后，本文提出在UDT中部署智能体AI的关键研究方向和挑战，勾勒面向复杂跨学科城市系统的可扩展、用户导向和半自主化管理路径。
